When we are closed for staff training you can again still get through to us on our emergency line if your call is urgent, as stated in the phone message. Our Practice is closed for one afternoon per month for essential staff training and this has been approved by the ICB and is the case for all practices in Somerset. Closure dates for the year are always advertised on our website or on our Practice newsletter. We would highly recommend having a look at our monthly newsletter which is available in reception or on our facebook page, as this includes important information about when we're going to be closed, what our emergency line is and further advice with this, among other things. 
We apologise you don't think this is treating patients fairly, however we do everything possible to advise our opening times, closure days, explain our emergency line etc for patients so they understand why we do this and why it is necessary. There is always a way to get in touch with us if you need to urgently and our duty GP each day will always provide advice or signpost to the most appropriate service for you if required.
